connector.name: Cyclesite MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Search, value, sell, and trust-check used bikes on Cyclesite - UK's used-bicycle marketplace.
connector.summary: Hosted at cyclesite.co.uk over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package cyclesite-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tomalarrrr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CYCLESITE_API_URL
env.description: Cyclesite base URL. Override only for partner staging environments.

env.name: CYCLESITE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional partner API key for raised rate limits. Public tier works without one.
